settings.title: Session Migration
settings.desc: Place legacy logs (e.g. v0) onto the version contract this instance expects; DSH migrates the record automatically when it reads it.
status.title: Environment
status.layoutWarn: Bare directories found under sessions/ (they empty the workspace list): {dirs}
import.title: Import legacy sessions
import.desc: Pick legacy export files (.zip export bundles, .jsonl, .jsonl.zstd; multi-select supported). They are stored in {dir}.
list.title: Legacy sessions
list.desc: The plugin scans every legacy session under {dir} and records it as JSON. Tick items and click Convert to place them.
list.empty: No legacy sessions yet. Import some with the button above.
convert.title: Convert
convert.desc: Selected items are placed into the matching workspace directory with their cwd rewritten; DSH completes the version migration when it reads the record.
convert.workspaceHint: Converted sessions are bound to this workspace (session cwd is rewritten).
convert.noSelection: Tick the legacy sessions to convert first
convert.done: Placed; DSH completes the migration when it reads the record
convert.deduped: Session already exists in another workspace: {n} duplicate copy(ies) moved to session-backups (recoverable)
convert.modePlace: Place (DSH migrates when it reads the record)
convert.rewriteUnavailable: Plugin rewrite mode is not implemented; using place mode
